verdicts.reason: A has the wrong hierarchy. The Quillbrook logo is blown up to fill the left third and outweighs the headline. The CTA is shrunk to a tiny pill at the bottom with unreadable legal text jammed beside it, 'Ships late June' is set bigger than the body copy, the orange divider is missing, and the dark header bar survives only as a stray block in the top-right corner. B keeps the original's centred column and puts headline, body and CTA in the right order with a properly sized button. But it also has a broken leftover of the header bar in the top right, the logo is tiny and floats at the bar's edge, and the divider is orphaned far off to the right. The body copy and 'Ships late June' are small, and the right half of the canvas is empty.
